geo_notes: Nominatim has no entry for this address or name. Position taken from the Apple Maps place listing (38.5983886, -123.3009773), which agrees with OSM: a drinking-fountain node described as 'across the road from the retreat center' sits at 38.5996, -123.3011 and a cluster of ~30 building footprints lies at 38.598-38.601, -123.298 to -123.305. The venue's own Google Maps embed on /directions centers ~570 m west (38.60095, -123.30772), within the same large property. Note the site itself warns GPS/internet maps are unreliable here; the property is ~30 mi NW of Cazadero proper, between Fort Ross and Stewarts Point on the ridge above Hwy 1.
